title: On the other side of the music stand
summary: A moment from conducting the University of Minnesota University Band.
body:
In spring 2021, I conducted the University of Minnesota University Band. Here is a photograph from my musical life at Minnesota.

Most of the time, you will find me on clarinet. These days, I perform with the ODU Symphony Orchestra and the Chesapeake Bay Wind Ensemble.

photos.alt: Yi Tang conducting a band at the University of Minnesota
photos.caption: Conducting at Minnesota · Spring 2021
